title: creator-brand-visual-spec.v1
description: A visual identity spec for one platform profile. Every measurement carries where it came from. A platform that does not publish a size is recorded as not publishing it, so the next run stops looking and nobody fills the hole with a number that reads official.

delivery_language.description: BCP-47 tag of the language the Creator-facing strings are written in, such as en, zh-CN or pt-BR. The v1 values English and 中文 remain valid. Fixed labels in the rendered result are English.

role.description: What this colour is for. A palette without roles is a swatch, not a spec.

availability.description: Where the creator can actually get this face. A spec naming a font nobody can install is not executable.

direction.description: How the palette and type land on this surface, in words the creator can act on.

quote.description: The platform's own sentence, verbatim. Required whenever authority is official_help_page or official_secondary.

basis.description: How a non-official figure was arrived at, and whose figure it is. Required whenever authority is not official.

not_published.description: Surfaces the platform is measured not to publish a size for. Recording the absence is what stops the next run from inventing one.
